quarterly_data.signal: DoD award: fixed-price IDIQ contract N6893626D5012 to Keysight Technologies Inc. (Colorado Springs, Colorado) for repair, maintenance and calibration of signal generators, network analyzers and oscilloscopes, maintenance and support agreements, technical support, on-site calibration at naval facilities and instrument training, supporting Navy RDT&E test equipment; expected completion September 2031; not competitively procured; contracting activity Naval Air Warfare Center Weapons Division, China Lake, California.
